_comment: Authoring source for docs/l2-integration-tests/*.csv. Test ID and Coverage Technique come from @DisplayName strings in the test sources (scripts/l2-testcases.py check enforces the two-way match); this file holds the 15-column metadata that cannot be derived: SRS Reference, Feature, Priority, Services, Infrastructure, Mocks, Given/When/Then, Negative?, Notes, and optional statusOverride ('Blocked' for @Disabled H2/broker cases).

sheets.name: L2-Workflows
sheets.title: L2-Workflows  |  true two-transaction concurrency: optimistic loser, check-then-insert race, double start

L2-FLOW-01.g: One DRAFT training record; two threads each open a REAL transaction, load the record, and wait on a barrier so both hold the same @Version
L2-FLOW-01.w: Both threads modify the title and commit simultaneously (ExecutorService + CyclicBarrier)
L2-FLOW-01.t:
Exactly one commit wins; the loser throws ObjectOptimisticLockingFailureException (→ 409 SYS_409 over HTTP)
DB: winner's title persisted; version advanced exactly once
L2-FLOW-01.notes: The only true two-transaction optimistic-lock proof in the suite — every other 'stale version' test is a single-request compare
L2-FLOW-01.block: Block: concurrency proofs  |  no other test opens two real transactions

L2-FLOW-02.g: system_settings empty; thread A replays getOrCreate's check-then-insert and PARKS uncommitted; thread B calls the real systemSettingsService.get()
L2-FLOW-02.w: A holds its insert; B's insert blocks on the unique scope_key; A commits
L2-FLOW-02.t:
B fails with DataIntegrityViolationException
DB: exactly one GLOBAL row
No handler maps this exception → over HTTP the loser gets 500 SYS_001, not 409

L2-FLOW-03.g: OPEN assignment (maxAttempts 2), one target user, no attempts; two threads released together
L2-FLOW-03.w: Both threads call attemptService.start(assignment, user) simultaneously
L2-FLOW-03.t:
Neither fails: the PESSIMISTIC_WRITE on the target row serialises them
The second transaction finds the first's IN_PROGRESS attempt and returns it
DB: exactly ONE attempt row, attempt_number 1 — uq_exam_attempt_number holds
L2-FLOW-03.notes: H2's FOR UPDATE semantics differ from Postgres row locks — result verified here, but re-verify on Postgres before relying on it
